events.title: PCP annual physical — fatigue & increased thirst
events.summary: Routine annual physical with Dr. Levy. Patient reported three months of fatigue and gradually worsening increased thirst (polydipsia), along with intermittent blurred vision and nocturia.

source.snippet: Pt presents today for routine annual physical. Reports fatigue × 3 months and increased thirst.

events.title: Fasting glucose — 187 mg/dL (High)
events.summary: Fasting blood glucose was significantly elevated at 187 mg/dL, well above the normal range of 70–99 mg/dL, consistent with new-onset diabetes.

source.snippet: Glucose, fasting 187 H 70-99 mg/dL

events.title: HbA1c — 9.2% (High)
events.summary: Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) was markedly elevated at 9.2%, well above the normal range of 4.0–5.6%, consistent with new-onset Type 2 diabetes.

source.snippet: HbA1c: 9.2% (H) — Reference range 4.0-5.6%.

events.title: LDL cholesterol — 132 mg/dL (High)
events.summary: LDL (low-density lipoprotein, or 'bad' cholesterol) was elevated at 132 mg/dL, above the goal of less than 100 mg/dL.

source.snippet: LDL 132 H <100 mg/dL

events.title: New Dx: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (E11.9)
events.summary: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus was newly diagnosed and added to the active problem list, based on elevated fasting glucose and HbA1c results.

source.snippet: Assessment: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (E11.9) — added to problem list.

events.title: Borderline hyperlipidemia noted
events.summary: Borderline high cholesterol (hyperlipidemia) was identified. A statin medication was not started yet; a lifestyle trial will be tried first with lipids rechecked in 6 months.

source.snippet: Hyperlipidemia, borderline. Defer statin pending lifestyle trial; recheck lipids in 6 months.

events.title: Started metformin 500 mg twice daily
events.summary: Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily with meals was started as first-line treatment for newly diagnosed Type 2 diabetes.

source.snippet: Plan: Start metformin 500 mg PO b.i.d. with meals. F/u in 3 months for repeat A1c.

events.title: Referral to diabetes educator
events.summary: A referral was placed for diabetes education to help with managing the new Type 2 diabetes diagnosis.

source.snippet: Refer to diabetes educator. Home glucometer prescribed; check fasting BG 3×/week.

events.title: Prior HbA1c — 9.2% (referenced)
events.summary: A prior Hemoglobin A1c result of 9.2% was obtained on January 12, 2023, referenced in this report as the baseline for comparison. The April 2023 result of 8.4% represents an improvement from this value.

source.snippet: This result represents an improvement from a prior value of 9.2% obtained on 01/12/2023 under account 4471028.

events.title: HbA1c — 8.4% (elevated)
events.summary: Hemoglobin A1c (a 3-month average blood sugar marker) came back at 8.4%, which is above the normal range and above the typical diabetes management goal of under 7.0%. This is an improvement compared to the prior result of 9.2% from January 2023.

source.snippet: Test: Hemoglobin A1c. Result: 8.4 % (H). Reference: 4.0-5.6 %.

events.title: HbA1c — 8.4% (improved, still above goal)
events.summary: Glycated hemoglobin (A1c) improved from 9.2% to 8.4% compared to January, but remains above the treatment goal of less than 7.0%.

source.snippet: April lab work (drawn 04/18/2023) showed A1c improved from 9.2% to 8.4%, which is encouraging but still above the goal of <7.0%.

events.title: Prior HbA1c — 8.4% (referenced)
events.summary: A prior HbA1c result of 8.4% was drawn on April 18, 2023, referenced in this August 2023 report as the baseline for comparison.

source.snippet: HbA1c has decreased from 8.4% (drawn 04/18/2023) to 7.2%

events.title: Diabetes follow-up visit with Dr. Levy
events.summary: Three-month follow-up for Type 2 diabetes (T2D). Patient reported good adherence to metformin, improved energy, resolved excessive thirst, and home fasting blood glucose trending down to the 130–150 range from the initial 180s.

source.snippet: Pt returns for f/u of T2D. A1c 8.4% on metformin 500 b.i.d. Tolerating well, no GI sx.

events.title: Metformin dose increased to 1000 mg b.i.d.
events.summary: Metformin was increased from 500 mg to 1000 mg twice daily due to partial response. Patient was advised to titrate the dose gradually over 5 days to minimize stomach upset.

source.snippet: Δ metformin → 1000 mg PO b.i.d. F/u A1c in 3 months.

events.title: HbA1c — 7.2% (improved from 8.4%)
events.summary: Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) came back at 7.2%, still above the normal range but down from 8.4% four months prior, indicating the diabetes management plan is working. The general target for adults with diabetes is below 7.0%.

source.snippet: The patient's HbA1c has decreased from 8.4% (drawn 04/18/2023) to 7.2%, representing continued response to glycemic management. Goal A1c for non-pregnant adults with diabetes is generally <7.0%.

events.title: HbA1c — 7.2% (August draw)
events.summary: Glycated hemoglobin (A1c) measured at 7.2% in August — the best result since the patient's diabetes diagnosis in January. This value was referenced in the November visit note.

source.snippet: Her August A1c (drawn 08/21/2023) was 7.2%, the best reading since her diagnosis in January.

events.title: Prior HbA1c — 7.2% (Aug 2023)
events.summary: A prior HbA1c result of 7.2% was recorded in August 2023, referenced here as a comparison point to the current result showing improvement to 6.9%.

source.snippet: A1c trended from 7.2% (08/21/2023) to 6.9%.

events.title: Diabetes follow-up visit — well controlled
events.summary: Routine 3-month diabetes follow-up with Dr. Levy. Patient reported no hypoglycemic episodes, good energy, and 9 lbs of weight loss since January diagnosis. Foot exam was normal.

source.snippet: Sarah returns for routine 3-month diabetes follow-up. Her August A1c (drawn 08/21/2023) was 7.2%, the best reading since her diagnosis in January. She reports doing well overall. Sleep is normal, energy is good, no hypoglycemic episodes.

events.title: Metformin continued at 850 mg b.i.d.
events.summary: Metformin dose increased from the original 500 mg to 850 mg twice daily is continued unchanged. No new medications were added at this visit.

source.snippet: Continue metformin 850 mg PO b.i.d. as currently prescribed.

events.title: Referral placed — annual diabetic eye exam
events.summary: A referral for an annual diabetic eye exam was placed at this visit, as part of routine diabetes monitoring.

source.snippet: Annual diabetic eye exam referral placed (separate document).

events.title: HbA1c — 6.9% (at diabetes target)
events.summary: Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) came back at 6.9%, which is above the normal reference range but at or below the American Diabetes Association's recommended treatment target of less than 7.0% for adults with diabetes. This is an improvement from 7.2% in August 2023.

source.snippet: Hemoglobin A1c: 6.9 % (H). Reference range 4.0-5.6 %. Note: at target for diabetic patients (<7.0).

events.title: Fasting Lipid Panel — LDL 145 mg/dL (high)
events.summary: Fasting lipid panel showed LDL (bad cholesterol) of 145 mg/dL, above the optimal level of less than 100 mg/dL. Total cholesterol and non-HDL cholesterol were also elevated; HDL (good cholesterol) and triglycerides were within normal range.

source.snippet: LDL Cholesterol: 145 mg/dL (H). Reference: <100 mg/dL optimal.

events.title: LDL cholesterol — 145 mg/dL (borderline high)
events.summary: LDL (low-density lipoprotein, the 'bad' cholesterol) was 145 in April, above the typical target. Decision was made to continue lifestyle management rather than start a statin medication at that time.

source.snippet: Her April lipid panel showed an LDL of 145, which we discussed at the time and elected to manage with continued lifestyle measures rather than initiating a statin immediately.

events.title: Annual physical — PCP
events.summary: Routine annual physical with Dr. Levy. No new complaints. Exam was unremarkable including a normal diabetic foot exam. Type 2 diabetes (T2D) and borderline high cholesterol (HLD) reviewed.

source.snippet: Sarah returns for her routine annual physical. She is now 18 months out from her diabetes diagnosis.

events.title: Referral — annual diabetic eye exam
events.summary: A referral for the annual diabetic eye exam was noted as pending at this visit.

source.snippet: Annual diabetic eye exam due — referral pending.
